record.context_brief: Characterization of congruence lattices of SPS lattices
record.original_question: Which finite distributive lattices occur as congruence lattices of SPS lattices, where an SPS lattice is a finite slim planar semimodular lattice and 'slim' means that the lattice has no M3 sublattice? Equivalently, determine necessary and sufficient conditions for a finite distributive lattice D to be representable as Con L for some finite slim planar semimodular lattice L.

evidence.quote: Let us call a finite planar semimodular lattice L slim, if it has no M3 sublattice. Let us define an SPS lattice as a slim, finite, planar semimodular lattice L without an M3 sublattice. (SPS stands for Slim, Planar, Semimodular.)
Problem. Characterize the congruence lattices of SPS lattices.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A finite lattice $L$ is called semimodular if for all $a,b\in L$, whenever $a$ covers $a\wedge b$ then $a\vee b$ covers $b$. The lattice $L$ is called planar if it has a planar Hasse diagram, and slim if it contains no sublattice isomorphic to $M_3$ (the five-element modular nondistributive lattice with three atoms). An SPS lattice is a finite slim planar semimodular lattice.

For a finite lattice $L$, let $\operatorname{Con} L$ denote its congruence lattice; if $L$ is semimodular and finite then $\operatorname{Con} L$ is a finite distributive lattice.

Problem. Give necessary and sufficient conditions on a finite distributive lattice $D$ for there to exist an SPS lattice $L$ with $\operatorname{Con} L \cong D$. Equivalently, characterize the class of finite distributive lattices that arise as congruence lattices of finite slim planar semimodular lattices.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is generally regarded as open. A growing list of necessary conditions on $\operatorname{Con} L$ for SPS lattices $L$ has been established (e.g., having at least two dual atoms when $|L|>2$; properties proved by G. Grätzer and G. Czédli; and infinitely many further properties via Czédli's "lamps"). However, no complete characterization (necessary and sufficient conditions) has been published as of recent work in 2023–2024.

status_evidence.title: Notes on planar semimodular lattices. VIII. Congruence lattices of SPS lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Studies congruence lattices of SPS lattices and establishes new necessary properties.
status_evidence.claim: Active research giving partial necessary conditions, not a full characterization.

status_evidence.title: Infinitely many new properties of the congruence lattices of slim semimodular lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Presents infinitely many new properties of congruence lattices of slim semimodular lattices via lamps.
status_evidence.claim: New necessary conditions continue to be discovered, indicating the characterization problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: A new property of congruence lattices of slim, planar, semimodular lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Adds a new necessary property to the list of known properties of these congruence lattices.
status_evidence.claim: Supports that only partial results (necessary conditions) are known.
